say:1:1029102001:1.text: I will be the most devoted of thy kin, and oversee thy minions—
say:1:1029102001:1.source_cn: 我愿成为您最忠实的眷属，管理您的仆从——

say:3:1029102002:1.text: Child, it's too dangerous here. Please, head on home.
say:3:1029102002:1.source_cn: 这位小朋友，这里很危险，请远离此处。

say:4:1029102003:1.text: Ha. I am blood of the abyssal Hypogeans, whilst thou serve the light.
say:4:1029102003:1.source_cn: 呵。吾乃深渊恶魔之眷属，而汝，乃光明之党羽。

say:5:1029102004:1.text: I have long known thy true aim, which is solely to lead me against my lord. Do not think thou canst prevail!
say:5:1029102004:1.source_cn: 吾早已知悉到汝的真实目的，无非是欲引导吾背叛吾主。汝等...

say:7:1029102005:1.text: What's this girl talking about? Is Chippy just too dumb to understand?
say:7:1029102005:1.source_cn: 这个女孩在说什么？是我太笨了吗，怎么感觉完全听不懂……

say:9:1029102006:1.text: I don't think it's your problem for once, Chippy. I don't follow either...
say:9:1029102006:1.source_cn: 这次，应该不是满满的问题。因为我也听不太懂……

choice_prompt:10:1029102006.text: I don't think it's your problem for once, Chippy. I don't follow either...
choice_prompt:10:1029102006.source_cn: 这次，应该不是满满的问题。因为我也听不太懂……

say:11:1029102007:1.text: Wow, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're even able to understand her cryptic words!
say:11:1029102007:1.male: Wow, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're even able to understand her cryptic words!
say:11:1029102007:1.female: Wow, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're even able to understand her cryptic words!

say:13:1029102009:1.text: Look, over there! Seems a Hypofiend escaped the rift... and is heading straight for us!
say:13:1029102009:1.source_cn: 快看那边，裂隙里好像逸出了魔物……往我们这边扑过来了！

say:14:1029102010:1.text: It's a minion of Lord Syriosus! Thou'st heard my prayer, Lord... Huh?
say:14:1029102010:1.source_cn: 这是……赛利欧斯大人的仆从！赛利欧斯大人，您果然听到了...

say:16:1029102011:1.text: Magister! The Hypofiend's heading towards the girl!
say:16:1029102011:1.source_cn: 主人！那个魔物好像往女孩的方向去了！
say:16:1029102011:1.male: Magister! The Hypofiend's heading towards the girl!
say:16:1029102011:1.female: Magister! The Hypofiend's heading towards the girl!

say:18:1029102008:1.text: Since even Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> doesn't get it, this girl's gotta be the issue!
say:18:1029102008:1.male: Since even Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> doesn't get it, this girl's gotta be the issue!
say:18:1029102008:1.female: Since even Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> doesn't get it, this girl's gotta be the issue!

say:1:1029104001:1.text: Thanks for your help. I fear I would've had a hard time handling the Hypofiend if you hadn't been here...
say:1:1029104001:1.source_cn: 感谢各位的帮助。要不是有你们在，光凭我恐怕很难应付这些...

choice_prompt:2:1029104001.text: Thanks for your help. I fear I would've had a hard time handling the Hypofiend if you hadn't been here...
choice_prompt:2:1029104001.source_cn: 感谢各位的帮助。要不是有你们在，光凭我恐怕很难应付这些魔物……

say:3:1029104002:2.text: This is nothing for our magister!
say:3:1029104002:2.source_cn: 嘿嘿，这种程度的魔物，对主人来说根本不算什么！
say:3:1029104002:2.male: This is nothing for our magister!
say:3:1029104002:2.female: This is nothing for our magister!

say:5:1029104003:1.text: Hmph. This Hypofiend must be some lowly lackey who disobeys Lord Syriosus' commands! It even attacked me!
say:5:1029104003:1.source_cn: 哼。此等魔物，一定是不听从赛利欧斯大人命令的下等仆从！...

say:6:1029104004:1.text: Again! No one understands what you're talking about.
say:6:1029104004:1.source_cn: 又、又出现了！这种完全让人摸不着头脑的句子……

say:8:1029104005:1.text: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!
say:8:1029104005:1.source_cn: 是主人救了你，你不说谢谢也就算了，怎么连人话都不说！
say:8:1029104005:1.male: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!
say:8:1029104005:1.female: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!

say:10:1029104006:1.text: Only Lord Syriosus will ever have my respect. You are far from worthy.
say:10:1029104006:1.source_cn: 吾之敬意，永远只朝向赛利欧斯大人。汝等尚未够格。

say:11:1029104007:1.text: Should'st we one day tumble together into the abyss... Then I shall give thee deserved respect.
say:11:1029104007:1.source_cn: 若有朝一日，汝等与吾同坠深渊……届时，吾将赐予汝等应有...

choice_prompt:12:1029104007.text: Should'st we one day tumble together into the abyss... Then I shall give thee deserved respect.
choice_prompt:12:1029104007.source_cn: 若有朝一日，汝等与吾同坠深渊……届时，吾将赐予汝等应有的尊敬。

say:13:1029104008:1.text: Where I am, there be mine intention. Wherefore do I divulge such to you mortals?
say:13:1029104008:1.source_cn: 吾身处此地，自有吾的意图所在。而吾之意图，为何要与汝等...

say:15:1029104011:1.text: Oh, come on! I swear there's no reasoning with her.
say:15:1029104011:1.source_cn: 呜哇……感觉完全没办法和她沟通……

say:17:1029104012:2.text: Well... Actually, it's like this—I found this girl wandering around all alone, looking very suspicious.
say:17:1029104012:2.source_cn: 那个……其实事情是这样的，不久之前，我发现这个小女孩孤...

say:18:1029104013:1.text: I tried talking with her, but as you can see, I can't make heads or tails of what she's saying.
say:18:1029104013:1.source_cn: 我试图和她搭话，结果就像你们看到的一样，根本听不懂她在...

say:19:1029104014:1.text: So I just watched and waited a while... and I realized she wanted to investigate that evil rift.
say:19:1029104014:1.source_cn: 于是我就在她旁边观察了一番……这才知道她是想要调查那个...

say:20:1029104015:1.text: But that's so dangerous! A Hypofiend can emerge at any time, like you just saw.
say:20:1029104015:1.source_cn: 但这实在太危险了！这块区域时不时会冒出来一些魔物，就像...

say:21:1029104016:1.text: I have a request. I'm sorry if it's a bit forward, but there really isn't anyone else around who I could ask...
say:21:1029104016:1.source_cn: 那个……我有一个请求，可能有些失礼，但这附近也实在没有...

choice_prompt:22:1029104016.text: I have a request. I'm sorry if it's a bit forward, but there really isn't anyone else around who I could ask...
choice_prompt:22:1029104016.source_cn: 那个……我有一个请求，可能有些失礼，但这附近也实在没有其他人可以求助了……

say:23:1029104017:1.text: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?
say:23:1029104017:1.source_cn: 如果您方便的话……可以帮忙护送这个女孩带回去吗？
say:23:1029104017:1.male: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?
say:23:1029104017:1.female: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?

say:24:1029104018:1.text: She let slip that she's from Holistone. It would be a great relief if you could return her to the village.
say:24:1029104018:1.source_cn: 之前她透露过自己是圣石镇的居民，如果你们能把她送回镇子...

choice_prompt:25:1029104018.text: She let slip that she's from Holistone. It would be a great relief if you could return her to the village.
choice_prompt:25:1029104018.source_cn: 之前她透露过自己是圣石镇的居民，如果你们能把她送回镇子上就太好了。

say:26:1029104019:1.text: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.
say:26:1029104019:1.male: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.
say:26:1029104019:1.female: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.

say:30:1029104021:2.text: I am kin of Lord Syriosus. What can ye mortals do to me?
say:30:1029104021:2.source_cn: 吾乃赛利欧斯大人的眷属，汝等凡人能奈我何？

say:31:1029104022:1.text: Now's the time to be quiet! We'll get you safely home no matter what, even if we have to do it by force!
say:31:1029104022:1.source_cn: 这种时候你就别说话啦！反正不管怎么样，我们都会把你好好...

say:32:1029104023:1.text: Th-thou... Hmph. How vulgar to speak of force!
say:32:1029104023:1.source_cn: 汝、汝等……哼，以武力论事，庸俗！

choice:22:1:2.text: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.
choice:22:1:2.male: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.
choice:22:1:2.female: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.

choice:12:0:1.text: Anyway, what are you doing here?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 所以，你为什么会在这里？
choice:12:0:1.male: Anyway, what are you doing here?
choice:12:0:1.female: Anyway, what are you doing here?

say:34:1029104009:1.text: Purpose? All I have is with Lord Syriosus, and my purpose is to mirror his.
say:34:1029104009:1.source_cn: 吾的目的？吾的一切均与赛利欧斯大人同在，吾之目的，即为...

say:35:1029104010:1.text: Canst ye mortals even comprehend Lord Syriosus' purpose?
say:35:1029104010:1.source_cn: 赛利欧斯大人之意图，岂是汝等凡人得以知悉之物？

say:0:1029105001:0.text: We've already gotten the kid back to Holistone! Didn't even take that much time, either.
say:0:1029105001:0.source_cn: 我们已经顺利护送这家伙抵达圣石镇了。花费的时间比预想中...

say:1:1029105002:0.text: Are we just gonna leave her here by herself?
say:1:1029105002:0.source_cn: 不过，就把她一个人扔在这里不管了吗？

say:2:1029105003:0.text: Hey, if it isn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! What a coincidence to find you here.
say:2:1029105003:0.male: Hey, if it isn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! What a coincidence to find you here.
say:2:1029105003:0.female: Hey, if it isn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! What a coincidence to find you here.

say:1:1029106001:1.text: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
say:1:1029106001:1.source_cn: 我刚好在想你的事情呢。难道这就是所谓的“宿命的相逢”？...
say:1:1029106001:1.male: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
say:1:1029106001:1.female: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...

choice_prompt:2:1029106001.text: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.source_cn: 我刚好在想你的事情呢。难道这就是所谓的“宿命的相逢”？——等等！你们身边这个女孩子，看起来好像有点眼熟啊……
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.male: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...
choice_prompt:2:1029106001.female: I was just thinking about you. Is this what they call a "destined meeting?"—Hang on! That girl with you, she looks familiar...

say:4:1029106003:2.text: That weird manner of speaking... it IS you! Dora! Where have you been?
say:4:1029106003:2.source_cn: 这奇奇怪怪的说话方式……是你！朵拉！她怎么会和你们在一起？

say:6:1029106004:1.text: So her name's Dora, eh? What a surprisingly normal name!
say:6:1029106004:1.source_cn: 原来这个女孩叫朵拉呀，意外的个正常名字呢！

say:8:1029106005:1.text: Thou liest! That name be not mine! I am of the abyss, and my true name resounds throughout the whole world!
say:8:1029106005:1.source_cn: 汝等不要妄言，吾名并非如此！吾乃深渊之眷属，吾名响彻大地！

say:9:1029106006:1.text: Whole world? Maybe throughout the whole of Holistone, seeing as everyone knows you're the biggest troublemaker.
say:9:1029106006:1.source_cn: 什么响彻大地，响彻整个圣石镇还差不多，大家都知道你最能...

say:11:1029106008:1.text: Alright, don't deny it. I know you're Dora. So, what's she been up to this time?
say:11:1029106008:1.source_cn: 行了行了，别抵赖了，我知道你就是朵拉。所以她这次又惹上...

choice_prompt:12:1029106008.text: Alright, don't deny it. I know you're Dora. So, what's she been up to this time?
choice_prompt:12:1029106008.source_cn: 行了行了，别抵赖了，我知道你就是朵拉。所以她这次又惹上什么事了？

say:13:1029106009:1.text: The Sun Temple? You went by yourself to such a dangerous place? That takes some guts!
say:13:1029106009:1.source_cn: 日神殿？你竟然一个人去了那么危险的地方？真是长本事了啊！

say:14:1029106011:1.text: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!
say:14:1029106011:1.male: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!
say:14:1029106011:1.female: It's lucky you met Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, otherwise I reckon you would've been ripped apart by a Hypofiend!

say:15:1029106012:1.text: I can't just overlook such an incident. Come, we're going to talk to your parents about it.
say:15:1029106012:1.source_cn: 这事我可不能当没听到。走，跟我一起去和你父母好好聊聊。

say:16:1029106013:1.text: No, please! You can't tell them!

say:18:1029106014:1.text: Oh, so she can talk normally, after all...

say:20:1029106015:1.text: You were just talking weirdly like that on purpose!
say:20:1029106015:1.source_cn: 原来你之前说的那些奇怪句子，都是故意的啊！

say:21:1029106016:1.text: Please, Mr. Valen! Blame me all you want; just don't tell my parents... I'll be in so much trouble!
say:21:1029106016:1.source_cn: 求你了维伦先生，你要怎么责怪我都行，只要别告诉爸爸妈妈...

say:22:1029106017:1.text: They might ground me for the rest of my life. I'd be locked in the attic forever!
say:22:1029106017:1.source_cn: 说不定还会被禁足，往后余生都只能被关在家里的小阁楼，永...

say:23:1029106018:1.text: Not gonna happen. This is a big deal. You could have been killed, and your parents need to know.
say:23:1029106018:1.source_cn: 不可能，这可不是什么小事。但凡当时有什么意外，你就可能...

say:24:1029106019:1.text: Your parents aren't totally heartless, either. You won't be locked in the attic forever. Maybe a week at most.
say:24:1029106019:1.source_cn: 另外你父母也不是这么不通情理的人，不会把你永远关在阁楼...

say:25:1029106020:1.text: A w-week?! Isn't that bad enough?! Do you KNOW how long a week is or how terrible being grounded for that long would be? No! You have no idea!
say:25:1029106020:1.source_cn: 一、一周！这还不够可怕吗！你知道一周有多久吗，你知道禁...

say:27:1029106021:2.text: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!
say:27:1029106021:2.male: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!
say:27:1029106021:2.female: And thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. We're lucky you were there!

say:28:1029106022:1.source_cn: 维伦完全无视了朵拉的哀嚎呢……

say:29:1029106023:1.text: Well, I should be getting this little troublemaker back. We should grab a meal when you have time!
say:29:1029106023:1.source_cn: 那么，这个麻烦小孩我就先带走了。下次有空再一起吃饭啊！

say:31:1029106024:1.text: Wow! Dora was struggling so hard, but Valen just hauled her away!
say:31:1029106024:1.source_cn: 呜哇！朵拉还想要挣扎，直接被维伦拎走了呢！

choice:12:0:1.text: She ran off to the Sun Temple.
choice:12:0:1.male: She ran off to the Sun Temple.
choice:12:0:1.female: She ran off to the Sun Temple.

say:35:1029106010:1.text: Sneaking off to investigate the Hypogean Rift... Do you have a death wish?
say:35:1029106010:1.source_cn: 偷偷调查恶魔裂隙……你不想活啦？

say:1:1029109001:1.text: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?
say:1:1029109001:1.male: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?
say:1:1029109001:1.female: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?

choice_prompt:2:1029109001.text: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?
choice_prompt:2:1029109001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，你有看到朵拉吗？就是上次那个小女孩。
choice_prompt:2:1029109001.male: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?
choice_prompt:2:1029109001.female: Have you seen Dora, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>? That girl from before?

say:3:1029109002:1.text: She sneaked out again and hasn't come back! We're all frantically looking for her. Please let me know if you see her anywhere!
say:3:1029109002:1.source_cn: 这小女孩又偷偷跑溜出去了，到现在还没回来！我们正在忙着...

say:4:1029109003:1.text: Of course, if you do come across her, it would be even better if you just brought her straight back to the village!
say:4:1029109003:1.source_cn: 当然，如果你遇到她之后，直接把她带回镇子里，那就再好不过了！

choice_prompt:5:1029109003.text: Of course, if you do come across her, it would be even better if you just brought her straight back to the village!
choice_prompt:5:1029109003.source_cn: 当然，如果你遇到她之后，直接把她带回镇子里，那就再好不过了！

say:6:1029109004:1.text: Well, just tell me if you have any news and leave the rest to me. Thank you!
say:6:1029109004:1.source_cn: 总之如果能有她的消息，你告诉我一声就行，剩下的我来解决...

choice:5:0:1.text: I'll keep an eye out for Dora.
choice:5:0:1.male: I'll keep an eye out for Dora.
choice:5:0:1.female: I'll keep an eye out for Dora.

choice:2:1:2.text: What has she done this time?
choice:2:1:2.male: What has she done this time?
choice:2:1:2.female: What has she done this time?

say:0:1029110001:0.text: Magister, surely Dora wouldn't have sneaked off to the Sun Temple again?
say:0:1029110001:0.source_cn: 主人，朵拉不会又偷偷跑去日神殿了吧？
say:0:1029110001:0.male: Magister, surely Dora wouldn't have sneaked off to the Sun Temple again?
say:0:1029110001:0.female: Magister, surely Dora wouldn't have sneaked off to the Sun Temple again?

say:1:1029110002:0.text: Well, it's possible. She seems a little obsessed with Hypogeans.
say:1:1029110002:0.source_cn: 嗯，很有可能。她好像对恶魔有一些特别的执着。
say:1:1029110002:0.male: Well, it's possible. She seems a little obsessed with Hypogeans.
say:1:1029110002:0.female: Well, it's possible. She seems a little obsessed with Hypogeans.

say:2:1029110003:0.text: But the Sun Temple really is too dangerous. Anyway, let's go look for her.
say:2:1029110003:0.source_cn: 但日神殿太危险了，总之，先去找找看吧。
say:2:1029110003:0.male: But the Sun Temple really is too dangerous. Anyway, let's go look for her.
say:2:1029110003:0.female: But the Sun Temple really is too dangerous. Anyway, let's go look for her.

say:2:1029111001:1.text: Sorry for disturbing you, but we need to ask if you've seen—
say:2:1029111001:1.source_cn: 抱歉打扰了，我们有个重要的事情想和你打听一下，你有没有...

choice_prompt:3:1029111001.text: Sorry for disturbing you, but we need to ask if you've seen—
choice_prompt:3:1029111001.source_cn: 抱歉打扰了，我们有个重要的事情想和你打听一下，你有没有见到过——

say:4:1029111002:1.text: What do you mean by that?
say:4:1029111002:1.source_cn: 胡言乱语的小女孩？”胡言乱语“是指？

say:5:1029111003:1.text: Like, a little girl saying weird things! About Hypogeans, or the abyss...
say:5:1029111003:1.source_cn: 就是会说一些很莫名其妙的话！什么恶魔啦，深渊啦之类的东西……

say:6:1029111004:1.text: Dura above, I've never met a girl who babbles about "Hypogeans". If I do, I'll try to free her from such possessions.
say:6:1029111004:1.source_cn: 女神在上，我不曾见过说着“恶魔”的女孩。如果见到的话，...

say:7:1029111006:1.text: Seems like Dora's not here. Let's go ask someone else!
say:7:1029111006:1.source_cn: 唔……看来朵拉确实不在这边呢。去找别人问问看吧！

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 一个胡言乱语的小女孩？

say:9:1029111005:1.text: Odd little girl? No. This is not a place for children. If I saw any kids here, I'd send 'em straight home.
say:9:1029111005:1.source_cn: 奇奇怪怪的小女孩？我没有见过。这里并不是小孩子该来的地...

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 一个奇奇怪怪的小女孩？

say:2:1029112001:1.text: May Dura protect you. How can I help?
say:2:1029112001:1.source_cn: 愿女神庇佑您。诸位有什么事吗？

say:3:1029112002:1.text: Esteemed acolyte, we'd like to ask about a very serious matter. Have you seen an odd little girl around here?
say:3:1029112002:1.source_cn: 修士大人，我们想要和你打听一件重要的事……你有没有在这...

say:4:1029112003:1.text: Oh! You mean the girl who keeps talking about "Syriosus", "the abyss", "kin", and all that weird stuff?
say:4:1029112003:1.source_cn: 胡言乱语……啊！那个一直说什么“赛利欧斯”“深渊”“眷...

choice_prompt:5:1029112003.text: Oh! You mean the girl who keeps talking about "Syriosus", "the abyss", "kin", and all that weird stuff?
choice_prompt:5:1029112003.source_cn: 胡言乱语……啊！那个一直说什么“赛利欧斯”“深渊”“眷属”之类奇怪词汇的小女孩吗？

say:6:1029112004:1.text: She was here not long ago. She may have been mumbling words of evil, but I didn't sense any strange aura.
say:6:1029112004:1.source_cn: 就在不久之前，她出现在了这里。虽然口中念念有词着邪恶的...

say:7:1029112005:1.text: When I tried to exorcise her, she yelled something like "Impudence" and "Stand down", then ran off...
say:7:1029112005:1.source_cn: 当我试图给她驱魔时，她喊着什么“放肆”“退下”之类的话...

say:8:1029112006:1.text: I can just imagine Dora saying that... Do you remember in which direction she ran?
say:8:1029112006:1.source_cn: 感觉耳边已经能听到朵拉说这些话的声音了……那你还记得她...

say:9:1029112007:1.source_cn: 她应该是去了西边的方向。

say:10:1029112008:1.text: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!
say:10:1029112008:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，修士大人！主人，我们去西边看看吧！
say:10:1029112008:1.male: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!
say:10:1029112008:1.female: Thank you, esteemed acolyte! Let's head west, Magister!

say:0:1029113001:0.text: Hey! Could this be... Dora's notebook?
say:0:1029113001:0.source_cn: 诶！这个莫非是……朵拉的笔记本？

say:0:1029114001:0.text: I can barely understand this either.

say:1:1029114002:0.text: At least we know she came through here. She wrote... about some ruins? Let's check them out.
say:1:1029114002:0.source_cn: 最起码证明了她曾来过这里，至于内容……遗迹群吗？先去那...
say:1:1029114002:0.male: At least we know she came through here. She wrote... about some ruins? Let's check them out.
say:1:1029114002:0.female: At least we know she came through here. She wrote... about some ruins? Let's check them out.

say:0:1029115001:0.text: It seems like someone's fighting Hypofiends over there... It's Dora! She's surrounded!
say:0:1029115001:0.source_cn: 那边好像有人正在和魔物战斗……是朵拉！她被魔物围攻了！

say:1:1029115002:0.text: But it seems like someone else is there too—it's the Celestial, Scarlita! What's she doing here?
say:1:1029115002:0.source_cn: 不对，好像还有其他人在……是、是半神斯克嘉莉德大人！她...

say:2:1029117001:2.text: How'd you get rid of the Hypofiends with your eyes closed the whole time? There's no way you could see!
say:2:1029117001:2.source_cn: 你的眼睛一直闭着，是看不到吗？你竟然还准确地清除了魔物？

say:3:1029117002:1.text: Do not worry; I'm not blind.

say:4:1029117003:1.text: Well, it doesn't matter. Lord Syriosus would have come to help, even if you hadn't stepped in!
say:4:1029117003:1.source_cn: 你说话怎么又慢又怪的……无所谓，就算你刚刚没有出手，赛...

say:6:1029117005:1.text: How can you be so dull? Just by hearing such a dashing name, you should know that Lord Syriosus must be a Hypogean!
say:6:1029117005:1.source_cn: 你怎么这么迟钝。听这个帅气的名字叫就知道，赛利欧斯大人...

say:7:1029117006:1.text: A Hypogean? I've never heard of him.

say:8:1029117007:1.text: Pff, of course you haven't, because I just made it up—I mean, a higher being informed me!
say:8:1029117007:1.source_cn: 哼哼，你当然没听过，因为是他们瞎编——不对，是我接收到...

say:9:1029117008:1.text: Hypogeans... offer no information or guidance to mortals.
say:9:1029117008:1.source_cn: 恶魔……不会给予人类指引。

say:10:1029117009:1.text: W-what are you saying?! Of course they do! Are you calling me a liar?
say:10:1029117009:1.source_cn: 你、你乱说什么呢！恶魔就是会这样的，我肯定比你更懂恶魔好吧！

say:12:1029117010:1.text: Uh, excuse me... Why are you here, Archon Scarlita?
say:12:1029117010:1.source_cn: 那个，打断一下。半神斯克嘉莉德大人，您为何在此处？

say:13:1029117011:1.text: I was just passing through and saw the Hypofiends attacking this child.
say:13:1029117011:1.source_cn: 我，并非特意来到此处，路过而已。魔物攻击她，必须消灭——

say:14:1029117012:1.text: I see. Well, this girl is Dora. We were actually looking for her!
say:14:1029117012:1.source_cn: 原来如此，这个小女孩是朵拉，我们就是来寻找她的！

say:15:1029117013:1.text: That is good, for this place is dangerous. Dora, Hypogeans never offer guidance to humans, only temptation. Be on your guard. Farewell, everyone.
say:15:1029117013:1.source_cn: 如此甚好，此地危险。朵拉，恶魔从不指引人类，唯有诱惑，...

say:2:1029118001:1.text: Hypofiends are really scary... I really thought I was going to die...
say:2:1029118001:1.source_cn: 魔物简直太吓人了吧……刚刚我还以为自己真的要完蛋了……

choice_prompt:3:1029118001.text: Hypofiends are really scary... I really thought I was going to die...
choice_prompt:3:1029118001.source_cn: 魔物简直太吓人了吧……刚刚我还以为自己真的要完蛋了……

say:4:1029118002:1.text: *Sniffle* Thank you for saving me! If it wasn't for you, I might have really been in trouble this time...
say:4:1029118002:1.source_cn: 呜呜……谢谢你们救我！要不是你们，我可能这回真的要栽在...

say:5:1029118003:1.text: And no Hypogean appeared to handle those Hypofiend minions! I almost got hurt... Hmph! I'm never gonna like Hypogeans ever again!
say:5:1029118003:1.source_cn: 结果根本没有恶魔出来管这些魔物仆从！还差点害我……哼，...

say:6:1029118004:1.text: As long as you know! Now, you'd better hurry back with us to Holistone.
say:6:1029118004:1.source_cn: 你知道就好！赶紧和我们乖乖回去圣石镇吧。

say:7:1029118005:1.text: Of course! But before that, I've got one question.
say:7:1029118005:1.source_cn: 当然！在那之前，我还有最后一个小问题……

say:8:1029118006:1.text: That weird woman just now... Who was she?
say:8:1029118006:1.source_cn: 刚刚那个说话慢吞吞，看起来奇奇怪怪的大姐姐……到底是谁呀？

say:9:1029118007:1.text: She's a Celestial. Archon Scarlita is as awesome as the magister and is capable of fighting off the Hypogeans!
say:9:1029118007:1.source_cn: 是半神斯克嘉莉德大人。她……和主人一样厉害，是能够对抗...
say:9:1029118007:1.male: She's a Celestial. Archon Scarlita is as awesome as the magister and is capable of fighting off the Hypogeans!
say:9:1029118007:1.female: She's a Celestial. Archon Scarlita is as awesome as the magister and is capable of fighting off the Hypogeans!

say:10:1029118008:1.text: Oh, so that's a Celestial. How elegant! Now it looks like those in the Shadow Chasers were wrong all along!
say:10:1029118008:1.source_cn: 原来、原来这就是半神……好帅气！这么看来，追影者说的根...

say:11:1029118009:1.text: They said Hypogeans are the most powerful, but clearly Celestials are the coolest! Though I haven't seen a Hypogean yet...
say:11:1029118009:1.source_cn: 什么恶魔最厉害了……明明半神看起来更酷！虽然我也没见过...

choice_prompt:12:1029118009.text: They said Hypogeans are the most powerful, but clearly Celestials are the coolest! Though I haven't seen a Hypogean yet...
choice_prompt:12:1029118009.source_cn: 什么恶魔最厉害了……明明半神看起来更酷！虽然我也没见过恶魔就是了……

say:13:1029118010:1.text: Uh oh! I probably shouldn't have said that...
say:13:1029118010:1.source_cn: 啊，完蛋！不小心说漏嘴了……

say:14:1029118011:1.text: Actually... it's just a little Hypogean research group. Some of the other kids in Holistone set it up.
say:14:1029118011:1.source_cn: 其实……其实就是一个研究恶魔的组织啦，是圣石镇上的其他...

say:15:1029118012:1.text: Research Hypogeans? You Holistone kids really have some particular interests.
say:15:1029118012:1.source_cn: 研究恶魔？你们圣石镇的小孩，兴趣爱好还真是特别。

say:16:1029118013:1.text: They heard a story about Hypogeans from a minstrel, and the more they looked into it, the more interested they got... and eventually formed the "Shadow Chasers".
say:16:1029118013:1.source_cn: 他们偶然听到了吟游诗人说的恶魔故事，越是研究就越是崇拜...

choice_prompt:17:1029118013.text: They heard a story about Hypogeans from a minstrel, and the more they looked into it, the more interested they got... and eventually formed the "Shadow Chasers".
choice_prompt:17:1029118013.source_cn: 他们偶然听到了吟游诗人说的恶魔故事，越是研究就越是崇拜……最后就搞了“追影者”这个组织。

say:18:1029118014:1.text: Well... I'm actually not a member.

say:19:1029118016:1.text: I have a rather special relationship with the Shadow Chasers. It's not easy to join; you have to take a test and everything!
say:19:1029118016:1.source_cn: 我和追影者的关系，稍微有那么一点特殊……追影者的入会门...

say:20:1029118017:1.text: I... don't really understand some of the stuff. I've already failed three times...
say:20:1029118017:1.source_cn: 我……那个有些东西不太理解，考了三次都没能通过……

say:22:1029118018:1.text: So you do actually want to join the Shadow Chasers, but haven't been able to because you failed the test?
say:22:1029118018:1.source_cn: 所以你其实是想参加追影者，但是因为考核不通过，一直都没...

say:24:1029118019:1.text: That's right. I was angry and eavesdropped on their conversation! They said that Hypogeans have been appearing near the Sun Temple recently!
say:24:1029118019:1.source_cn: 是这样没错啦……所以我一气之下偷听了追影者成员的聊天！...

say:25:1029118020:1.text: If I could see one for myself, then surely they'd let me join.
say:25:1029118020:1.source_cn: 要是能亲眼看到恶魔，区区一个小小的追影者，岂不是要求着...

choice_prompt:26:1029118020.text: If I could see one for myself, then surely they'd let me join.
choice_prompt:26:1029118020.source_cn: 要是能亲眼看到恶魔，区区一个小小的追影者，岂不是要求着我来参加？

say:27:1029118021:1.text: Right! And I even got badly told off by my parents...
say:27:1029118021:1.source_cn: 没错！而且回家之后我还被爸爸妈妈狠狠骂了一顿……

say:28:1029118022:1.text: But I wouldn't let such a small setback stop me! So I sneaked back out again...
say:28:1029118022:1.source_cn: 但是我是不会因为这种小小的挫折就止步不前的！所以我又偷...

choice_prompt:29:1029118022.text: But I wouldn't let such a small setback stop me! So I sneaked back out again...
choice_prompt:29:1029118022.source_cn: 但是我是不会因为这种小小的挫折就止步不前的！所以我又偷偷溜了回来……

say:30:1029118023:1.text: Yes... Those Hypofiends were really scary. Lucky you were there to help...
say:30:1029118023:1.source_cn: 是啊……那些魔物简直太可怕了。还好有人帮忙……

say:31:1029118025:1.text: Anyway, that's basically the whole story. Thank you for rescuing me, not once but twice...
say:31:1029118025:1.source_cn: 总之，事情差不多就是这样。谢谢你们救了我，而且还是两次……

say:32:1029118026:1.text: As long as you've learned your lesson! And don't run off alone to such places again.
say:32:1029118026:1.source_cn: 你知道错了就好！下次可别再一个人跑到这种地方来啦。

choice:29:0:1.text: And ended up running into Hypofiends.
choice:29:0:1.male: And ended up running into Hypofiends.
choice:29:0:1.female: And ended up running into Hypofiends.

say:34:1029118024:1.text: Y-you remembered that?! Forget I said it... Please, just forget it!
say:34:1029118024:1.source_cn: 你、你怎么还记得这句话！快点忘掉……求求你忘掉！

choice:29:1:2.text: And now you're "never gonna like Hypogeans ever again".
choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 然后就“永远不要喜欢恶魔”了
choice:29:1:2.male: And now you're "never gonna like Hypogeans ever again".
choice:29:1:2.female: And now you're "never gonna like Hypogeans ever again".

choice:26:0:1.text: But you never actually saw anything.
choice:26:0:1.male: But you never actually saw anything.
choice:26:0:1.female: But you never actually saw anything.

choice:26:1:2.text: But we ended up escorting you back.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 结果你被我们护送回去了
choice:26:1:2.male: But we ended up escorting you back.
choice:26:1:2.female: But we ended up escorting you back.

say:35:1029118015:1.text: Eh? Do I look like a leader to you?
say:35:1029118015:1.source_cn: 诶？我看起来很像是元老级别的人吗？哈哈哈，还是第一次有...

choice:17:1:2.text: Are you one of their leaders?
choice:17:1:2.male: Are you one of their leaders?
choice:17:1:2.female: Are you one of their leaders?

say:0:1029119001:0.text: Everyone's worried about you. Let's go, we'll escort you back.
say:0:1029119001:0.source_cn: 所有人都很担心你，走吧，我们送你回去。
say:0:1029119001:0.male: Everyone's worried about you. Let's go, we'll escort you back.
say:0:1029119001:0.female: Everyone's worried about you. Let's go, we'll escort you back.

say:1:1029119002:0.text: Okay! Once back, I'll turn over a new leaf and never do anything dangerous again.
say:1:1029119002:0.source_cn: 好的！回去之后，我一定洗心革面重新做人，再也不会做这么...

say:2:1029120001:2.text: Hey, Dora! How does it feel to be caught again?
say:2:1029120001:2.source_cn: 呦，朵拉，再被抓回来的感受如何？

say:3:1029120002:2.text: Hmph. I, for one, won't run away again. So take me home, and if I get grounded, then so be it...
say:3:1029120002:2.source_cn: 哼，我，反正我不会再偷跑了，你带我回家吧，关禁闭就关禁闭……

say:4:1029120003:1.text: You're suddenly acting so honest. You're not already scheming something again, are you...?
say:4:1029120003:1.source_cn: 你怎么这么老实？不会又在打什么坏主意吧……

say:6:1029120004:1.text: When we found Dora, she'd almost been caught by Hypofiends. She was so scared that she said she'd give up on joining the Shadow Chasers—
say:6:1029120004:1.source_cn: 我们见到朵拉的时候，她差点被魔物抓到。朵拉很害怕，她现...

say:8:1029120005:2.text: Hang on, you can't tell Mr. Valen about that!
say:8:1029120005:2.source_cn: 等等，你们……别和维伦先生说这个啊！

say:9:1029120006:1.text: The Shadow Chasers? Now, that does sound interesting. If I'm not mistaken, that seems like the dangerous group led by Makta and that lot, right?
say:9:1029120006:1.source_cn: “追影者”……听起来确实有趣。如果我没猜错的话，这个看...

say:11:1029120008:1.text: Because I know everything. I also know that, as a knight of justice, I can't just overlook such an evil group.
say:11:1029120008:1.source_cn: 我当然知道。我还知道，作为一名正义的骑士，我可不能放着...

say:12:1029120009:1.text: Tell me, what exactly do those Shadow Chasers do?
say:12:1029120009:1.source_cn: 说吧，你们这个“追影者”都干了什么事啊？

say:13:1029120010:1.text: They only research some legends about Hypogeans. For example, they say that they're stronger than Celestials—
say:13:1029120010:1.source_cn: 就是，就是研究了一些恶魔的传说。比如说在传说中，恶魔比...

say:14:1029120011:1.text: Because Celestials are demigods, right?! And if Hypogeans can fight like gods, then they can easily beat demigods.
say:14:1029120011:1.source_cn: 因为“半神”有一个“半”字在前面嘛！恶魔能和神打得不相...

say:16:1029120012:1.text: You don't get it! Celestials aren't weaker than Hypogeans. Weren't you just saved by Archon Scarlita?! She's a Celestial!
say:16:1029120012:1.source_cn: 你这完全是望文生义吧！半神才不会比恶魔弱呢，你之前不就...

say:17:1029120013:1.text: Of course, the Celestial who saved me was amazing! But Hypogeans just sound cooler! Even the name feels rebellious and dark!
say:17:1029120013:1.source_cn: 之前救我的半神大姐姐当然很厉害！可是恶魔就是感觉听起来...

choice_prompt:18:1029120013.text: Of course, the Celestial who saved me was amazing! But Hypogeans just sound cooler! Even the name feels rebellious and dark!
choice_prompt:18:1029120013.source_cn: 之前救我的半神大姐姐当然很厉害！可是恶魔就是感觉听起来更酷嘛！光是恶魔这个词一说出去，就有种叛逆，帅气，强大的感觉！

say:19:1029120014:2.text: It's nothing to do with age, okay?! And you've never seen a Hypogean, either.
say:19:1029120014:2.source_cn: 这个和年龄没有关系吧！你又没见过恶魔。

say:20:1029120016:1.text: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!
say:20:1029120016:1.source_cn: 哼哼，这你可说到重点了，我们可不只是见过恶魔这么简单…...
say:20:1029120016:1.male: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!
say:20:1029120016:1.female: Not only have we seen a Hypogean... You're looking at Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, who's even FOUGHT one!

say:21:1029120017:1.text: R-Really?! You've actually fought a Hypogean? That's so cool!
say:21:1029120017:1.source_cn: 真、真的吗！竟然和恶魔战斗过……这也太厉害了吧！

say:22:1029120018:1.text: Hard to imagine, right? The magister is very humble and doesn't like to brag. Why don't you all worship Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> instead?

say:22:1029120018:1.female: Hard to imagine, right? The magister is very humble and doesn't like to brag. Why don't you all worship Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> instead?

say:23:1029120019:1.female: Hey, Hammie! I know how much you adore <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but now is not the time to be recruiting fans.

say:24:1029120020:1.text: Tell me the truth, Dora. Where is the base of the Shadow Chasers? As a member of the Heroic Order, I must eliminate such hidden dangers.
say:24:1029120020:1.source_cn: 朵拉，老实交代，你们这个危险组织“追影者”的基地，到底...

say:25:1029120021:1.text: ...I'm not gonna tell! If the group gets shut down, everyone in the Shadow Chasers will see me as a traitor!

choice_prompt:26:1029120021.text: ...I'm not gonna tell! If the group gets shut down, everyone in the Shadow Chasers will see me as a traitor!
choice_prompt:26:1029120021.source_cn: ……我才不要告诉你呢！要是组织没了，追影者的大家肯定会把我当成叛徒的！

say:27:1029120022:1.text: You may be right about that... No! No matter what, everyone's gonna hate me if I tell!
say:27:1029120022:1.source_cn: 这么说好像也没错……不对！不管怎么样，如果我说了，肯定...

say:28:1029120023:1.text: Think about it: what if the other members of Shadow Chasers are like you and put themselves in danger just because they want to see a Hypogean?
say:28:1029120023:1.source_cn: 你想想看，要是那些追影者的成员们也像你一样，因为想要见...

say:29:1029120024:1.text: You'd obviously be doing the right thing. How could you be hated when everyone in Holistone will be thanking you?

say:30:1029120025:1.text: Shut up! I'm not falling for it!
say:30:1029120025:1.source_cn: 你别说了，我不会上当的！

say:31:1029120026:1.text: *Sigh* I'd hoped it wouldn't get to this point, but since you're being so stubborn, I'm forced to play the ace up my sleeve.
say:31:1029120026:1.source_cn: 唉。我本来也不想走到这一步的。但既然你这么坚决，那我也...

say:32:1029120027:1.text: Let's go. We're gonna have a good talk with your parents about the Shadow Chasers.
say:32:1029120027:1.source_cn: 走吧，去找你爸妈，我们一起好好聊聊“追影者”的事情。

choice:26:0:1.text: But you haven't even joined them.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 你不是还没加入追影者吗？

choice:26:0:1.female: But you haven't even joined them.

choice:26:1:2.female: You can't be counted as a traitor.

say:35:1029120015:1.text: How would you know what Hypogeans are like? Don't tell me you've seen one.

say:1:1029121001:2.text: Oh my! I'd never have believed that my Dora could join such a wicked group!

say:2:1029121002:1.text: It's lucky Mr. Valen stopped you in time! Otherwise, I would never have seen you again!
say:2:1029121002:1.source_cn: 还好维伦先生及时拦住了你！不然的话，我一定就看不到完整...

say:5:1029121005:1.text: Hang on, Mother, I'm right here! I'm fine! Look! My hand's still warm! Don't cry!
say:5:1029121005:1.source_cn: 等等，妈妈，我还在呢！还好好的呢，手都还是热乎的……妈...

say:7:1029121006:2.source_cn: 朵拉，你竟然做出这种事，真令我失望！

say:9:1029121008:1.text: All that effort for a group you couldn't even get in?! There's no way my daughter could fail that badly!

say:12:1029121010:2.text: I don't care if they're good or bad! If my daughter can't have something, then neither can the other children!
say:12:1029121010:2.source_cn: 我才不管什么好组织坏组织，我女儿没有的东西，别人的孩子...

say:13:1029121011:1.text: Come now, Dora. Tell Mr. Valen where their base is and let him wipe them out!
say:13:1029121011:1.source_cn: 快，朵拉，你快把那个追影者的基地告诉维伦先生，让他把这...

say:14:1029121012:1.text: I do want to end the organization, but not because of that...
say:14:1029121012:1.source_cn: 我是要清除组织没错，但不是因为这个……

say:15:1029121013:1.text: Okay, fine! Stop arguing. I'll take Mr. Valen there.
say:15:1029121013:1.source_cn: 好了好了，你们都别吵了……我带维伦先生过去……

say:3:1029122002:2.source_cn: 朵拉，到了你发挥能力的时候了。

say:4:1029122003:1.text: I-I'm not actually a member of Shadow Chasers, it's not like I'd know their secret password...

say:5:1029122004:1.text: I see. That's troublesome. Maybe we should get your parents here to help?

say:8:1029122006:1.source_cn: 沉睡在业火中的深渊之子啊，吾是您最虔诚的眷属。

say:9:1029122007:1.text: Call the name of our Lord.

say:10:1029122008:1.text: Lord Syriosus, we sincerely pray for thy forgiveness.
say:10:1029122008:1.source_cn: 赛利欧斯大人，吾等眷属，唯虔诚祈祷之心，愿您宽恕。

say:11:1029122009:1.text: My Lord hears. You may enter.

say:0:1029123001:0.text: We'd better shut this group down as soon as possible!
say:0:1029123001:0.source_cn: 竟然有模有样的，但这种胡言乱语的“邪恶”组织……还是早...

say:1:1029123002:0.text: The back door is open. Let's go check it out.
say:1:1029123002:0.source_cn: 后门开了，我们去看看情况吧。

say:1:1029123002:0.female: The back door is open. Let's go check it out.

say:1:1029124001:1.text: What's Mr. Valen doing here...? Oh no! Run, everyone!

say:2:1029124002:1.text: ... What do you all want? We Shadow Chasers never bow to authority!

say:4:1029124003:1.source_cn: 没、没错！你们要是想来硬的，我华菲斯也绝对不会束手就擒！

say:5:1029124004:1.text: Please, kids, calm down. Considering your age, I'm not gonna be violent. I do, however, have to remind you all—
say:5:1029124004:1.source_cn: 各位小朋友们，放轻松。以你们的年纪，我当然是不会对各位...

say:6:1029124005:1.text: The Shadow Chasers is an illegal organization. As a member of the Heroic Order, I hereby declare its dissolution. Should anyone object...

say:7:1029124006:1.text: Then I shall round you all up and notify your parents to come collect you from General Hogan!

say:8:1029124007:1.text: O-Our parents? I'm done for! My mother and father will tear me to pieces...

My parents are scarier than Hypogeans!
 Please, Mr. Valen! Let us go!

say:13:1029124011:1.text: Hurry up and answer <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s question. Maybe I'll be more merciful when I'm in a better mood.

say:14:1029124012:1.text: Why don't we just tell them, Boss? Think of your parents! It's not too late... otherwise we're all done for!

say:16:1029124014:1.text: Oh? That's... not quite what I was expecting.
say:16:1029124014:1.source_cn: 哦？这倒还真是……意料之外的答案。

say:17:1029124015:1.text: Surprised? We made this group not to just worship Hypogeans, but to first summon them—
say:17:1029124015:1.source_cn: 哼哼，想不到吧？我们建立这个组织，并不是单纯地崇拜恶魔...

say:18:1029124016:1.text: And then give 'em a good kick in the shins!

say:19:1029124017:1.text: That's right! That way, not just our parents but also knights like Mr. Valen...
say:19:1029124017:1.source_cn: 没错！这样的话，不管是爸爸妈妈，又或者是像维伦先生这样...

say:20:1029124018:1.text: You grown-ups would have to recognize our strength!
say:20:1029124018:1.source_cn: 你们这些大人，一定会发自内心地认可我们的实力！

say:21:1029124019:1.text: We wouldn't just be the "kids" you keep talking about, but heroes who could vanquish the Hypogeans!
say:21:1029124019:1.source_cn: 我们再也不是你们口中的“小孩子”，而是能战胜恶魔的勇士！

say:22:1029124020:1.text: Oh, I'm getting excited just thinking about it.
say:22:1029124020:1.source_cn: 哎呀，真是光靠想象都让人热血沸腾……

say:23:1029124021:1.text: So that's it. You've gone through so much, all for that. How to put it... it's just so childish.
say:23:1029124021:1.source_cn: 原来如此……你们折腾这么多，就是为了这个目的啊。该怎么...

say:25:1029124022:1.text: Hang on a minute! That's not what you said to me!
say:25:1029124022:1.source_cn: 等一下！什么“先召唤出恶魔，然后再狠狠打败他们”……这...

say:26:1029124023:1.source_cn: 啊？我们……之前是怎么说的来着？

say:28:1029124025:1.text: And once that happened, those Hypofiends would obey us and not hurt us anymore!

say:32:1029124029:1.text: We need to embrace change in order to improve and look to the future! The Shadow Chasers now exist to vanquish Hypogeans!
say:32:1029124029:1.source_cn: 我们总要拥抱变化，才能变得更好。不要局限在过去，放眼看...

say:36:1029124032:1.text: I dunno why, but I've got a bad feeling about this...
say:36:1029124032:1.source_cn: 呃……不知道为什么，我突然有一种不太好的预感……

say:37:1029124033:1.text: Aren't those Hypofiends just the minions of Hypogeans? Since you can defeat them, surely the minions are a piece of cake, right?

say:41:1029124036:1.source_cn: 我也不知道啊！我都没见过真正的魔物呢……但我们之前研究...

say:42:1029124037:1.source_cn: 对哦，我们有专门的对付恶魔的特技！刚好可以在魔物身上试...

say:43:1029124038:1.text: Yeah! That's settled, then. Let's go battle a Hypofiend!

say:46:1029124040:1.source_cn: 我已经充分，完整，零距离地见识过真正的魔物了！

say:48:1029124042:1.source_cn: 我的教训明明已经很充分了！

say:49:1029124043:1.text: Sorry, no. I don't think it's really sunk in yet. Good luck!
